skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — add subtitles in English and burn them into the video — and get captioned...

latestVersion.changelog:
add-subtitle-to-video-file 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Easily add and burn subtitles into your video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Automatic subtitle generation and cloud rendering — no editing software needed.
- Supports uploading video files, checking credits, and downloading rendered videos.
- Guided prompts and user-friendly status updates for each step.
- Handles common errors with clear feedback and suggestions.
